items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: So him and I were real tight... Fate Marable, him and his gin. We was close.

ctx.x: Now, we talked about a lot of the people in the bands, worked with the bands. We talked about traveling to different countries and you've done a lot of different kinds of things. I wanted to get some of your recollections about some of the individuals in the bands who haven't been really written and talked about that much. Like Jimmy Blanton, for instance. What do you recall about him when he joined the band?

Well, Jimmy Blanton, the first time I heard him was in St. Louis. We were in St. Louis to play the Case Hotel the first time they ever had a colored band. And so the night before -- we had two days off so the night before I went out on the town, and Fate Marable had a lot of very good musicians played on his boat, you know. So him and I were real tight.

So he say, "I want you to come up here. There's a jam session tomorrow and my boys, some of them are going to be there." So I went up, and him and I, we sat down, just relaxing a little taste. He say, I got a bass player I want you to hear. So all right, I see this guy, young kid, nice looking boy. And he played -- two or three more bass players played before him.
